note: GFP state park on the west shore of Big Stone Lake north of Milbank, in oak woods above a timbered, rocky shore. Two campgrounds: the West campground strings along the wooded lakeshore, several of its sites looking out to the lake through the trees; the larger East campground sits in a more open area back from the shore. --Claude
